description: A DMS-ready document manager component with generic metadata support, per-item permissions, custom forms, and detail panel. Supports keyboard navigation, multiselect, inline rename, and context menu.

parameters.name: AllowMultipleAttachments
parameters.description: When true, allows one logical item to hold multiple physical file attachments.

parameters.name: AttachmentListTemplate
parameters.description: Custom template for rendering the attachment list inside the detail panel or edit modal.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the wrapper element.

parameters.name: CurrentPath
parameters.description: Current folder path. Two-way bindable.

parameters.name: CurrentPathChanged
parameters.description: Event fired when the current path changes.

parameters.name: DeleteForm
parameters.description: Custom delete confirmation form. When null, a default <see cref="TmDialog"/> is used.

parameters.name: DetailMode
parameters.description: How the detail panel is displayed. Default is <see cref="DocumentManagerDetailMode.SlideIn"/>.

parameters.name: DetailPanel
parameters.description: Custom detail / properties panel content.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: When true, disables all user interactions.

parameters.name: EditForm
parameters.description: Custom delete confirmation form. When null, a default is used.

parameters.name: ItemContextMenu
parameters.description: Custom context menu for an item. When null, no context menu is shown.

parameters.name: ItemMetaTemplate
parameters.description: Template rendered below the item name in list/grid views (e.g. tags, metadata preview).

parameters.name: NewFolderForm
parameters.description: Custom form for creating a new folder. When null, a default inline input is used.

parameters.name: OnItemOpen
parameters.description: Event fired when an item is opened (double-clicked or Enter).

parameters.name: OnSelectionChanged
parameters.description: Event fired when the selection changes.

parameters.name: RespectPermissions
parameters.description: When true, hides actions the current user is not permitted to perform.

parameters.name: ShowCopyButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the Copy button. Default is false.

parameters.name: ShowDeleteButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the Delete button. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowDetailButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the Detail / Properties button. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowDownloadButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the Download button. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowEditButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the Edit button. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowFolderTree
parameters.description: Whether to show the folder tree sidebar. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowMoveButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the Move button. Default is false.

parameters.name: ShowNewFolderButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the New Folder button. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowRenameButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the Rename button. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowUploadButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the Upload button. Default is true.

parameters.name: UploadForm
parameters.description: Custom form for uploading files with metadata. When null, a simple file input is used.

parameters.name: ViewMode
parameters.description: Display mode (List or Grid). Default is <see cref="DocumentManagerViewMode.List"/>.

parameters.name: ViewModeChanged
parameters.description: Event fired when the view mode changes.
